title: Spy × Family
source: Spy × Family manga by Tatsuya Endo (ongoing). Snapshots use the latest published arc.
world: Cold-war style rivals Westalis and Ostania keep a fragile peace. Westalis's top spy, codename Twilight, becomes Loid Forger and builds a fake family to get close to politician Donovan Desmond through his son at the elite Eden Academy. He adopts Anya, who secretly reads minds, and marries Yor, who is secretly the assassin Thorn Princess. None of them knows the others' secrets except Anya. A warm, funny family comedy with spy action.
power_system: No magic. Anya can read minds (from a secret experiment); the family dog Bond can see the future. Everything else is spy craft and Yor's superhuman fighting.
